final: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(1.0 * Bytes / Milliseconds) AS byte_rate FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), cross_average AS (SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS avg_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT AVG(avg_unit_price) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(byte_rate) AS avg_byte_rate, AVG(byte_rate - avg_rate) AS avg_excess_rate FROM media_rates CROSS JOIN cross_average WHERE byte_rate > avg_rate
